summary: Work Orders – Technicians Cannot Add Parts; "Save & Close" Does Nothing
reported_issue: Account-specific (Gearhead Mechanical). Technicians cannot add a part to a work order: when they open the Add Part window and click Save & Close, the modal does nothing (it does not close and the part is not added). Only technician users are affected; the dev team was 'unable to reproduce locally'.
expected_after_fix: A technician (with add-parts permission) should be able to add a part via the Add Part window and have Save & Close persist the part and close the modal.
role_used: tech (assigned org 'Technician' role for the test, then restored to Time Clock)
steps_i_followed: As admin, assigned the org 'Technician' role (46298550-...) to the Tech staff member; fresh Tech login.
Checked fe-permissions: Technician role has woPickParts=true but woAddParts=false.
As Tech, opened WO S9-24948 Lines/Parts; opened the New Line modal (the add-part entry point).
Attempted to fill the required 'What Are You Doing?' field and click Save & Close / Save & Add Part.
Restored Tech to the Time Clock role and verified.
actual_now: As the Technician, the add-part flow UI is present and reachable: the WO shows 'New Line', and the New Line modal renders the buttons 'Save & Add Part', 'Save & Add Line', and 'Save & Close' (screenshot). So a technician is NOT blocked from opening the add-part UI. I could not complete an automated Save & Close click sequence to confirm/deny the 'does nothing' symptom - the Quasar combobox ('What Are You Doing?') and button targeting resisted automation in the harness. No product-side failure (button doing nothing) was directly observed, but a clean positive confirmation of a successful save was also not captured. Note: the org Technician role has woAddParts=false, so a stock technician lacks the add-parts permission - the affected client likely has add-parts enabled for their technician role.
notes: Account-specific bug the vendor could not reproduce locally. On staging the add-part UI (incl. Save & Close) is present and reachable for the Technician role, but I could not drive Save & Close to a confirmed success/failure within the harness (Quasar modal automation limits + tool budget). To close this out: reproduce with the client's exact technician role permission set (they have add-parts on) and confirm whether Save & Close persists the part. woAddParts=false on the stock Technician role here means a permission-config difference may be involved.
